Tariq Raman
tariq.raman@example.com | Indianapolis, IN
Tariq Raman has 7 years of experience in design. Most recently, Senior Product
Designer at Mesquite Group (2022-2026), where they designed and prototyped
features in Figma used by 14+ engineers to build against. Before that, Product
Designer at Pixel & Pine Group (2020-2022). Before that, Junior Product
Designer at Vineland Media (2019-2020). Education: M.S. Human-Computer
Interaction, Arizona State University, 2019; B.S. Human-Computer Interaction,
Columbia University, 2016. Core skills: Wireframing, Adobe XD, Figma, Visual
design, Prototyping, Design systems.
